p.src: 1  Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

ja: 々は激しく怒り、 人々はむなしいことを
en: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
u.src: 1  Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

p.src: 2  The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

en: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
u.src: 2  The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

ja: 2:2 「油注がれた者」という言葉は「メシア」または「キリスト」と同じである。
en: 2:2 The word “Anointed” is the same as the word for “Messiah” or “Christ”

p.src: 3  “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

ja: を断ち切り、 彼らの
en: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
u.src: 3  “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

p.src: 4  He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

ja: の座に着いておられる
en: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
u.src: 4  He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

ja: 2:4 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。

p.src: 5  Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

en: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
u.src: 5  Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

p.src: 6  “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

en: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
u.src: 6  “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

p.src: 7  I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

ja: はあなたの父となった。
en: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
u.src: 7  I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

p.src: 8  Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

en: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
u.src: 8  Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

p.src: 9  You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

en: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
u.src: 9  You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

p.src: 10  Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

en: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
u.src: 10  Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

p.src: 11  Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

ja: え、 おののきをもって
en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
u.src: 11  Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

p.src: 12  Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

ja: びないために。 主の激しい
がるからである。 主に避け所を求めるすべての
en: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
u.src: 12  Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

ja: 2:12 あるいは、子に心からの敬意を表せ
